claims.claim_summary: Fixed purposive cohort of 42: 10 UC, 8 Ivy, SDSU plus 23 other institutions.
claims.qualification: Selection protocol fixed before this study computed cohort rates; originating research already contained some results. Not preregistered or nationally representative.

claims.claim_summary: 2025 is the latest public bulk collection found at 25 September 2026 retrieval; report years 2022–2024.
claims.qualification: A retrieval snapshot, not a promise about future releases. Archive preparation date is not a publication date.

claims.claim_summary: One federal collection supplies primary counts; campus ASRs can differ.
claims.qualification: No selective replacement and no unsupported chronology claim.

claims.claim_summary: Counts use report year, potentially earlier occurrence year.
claims.qualification: Section (c)(3); course-of-conduct rules can also matter.

claims.claim_summary: Reported offenses are not convictions, unique victims or report forms.
claims.qualification: Section (c)(2) concerns report inclusion; UCSC provides a direct multiple-offense example.

claims.claim_summary: Reports can concern staff, visitors or nonstudents.
claims.qualification: Does not assert a measured fraction of nonstudents at any particular institution.

claims.claim_summary: Housing is a subset of on campus; noncampus and public property are separate.
claims.qualification: Correct geography paragraph is (c)(5), not hate-bias paragraph (c)(4).

claims.claim_summary: Combined view sums eleven specified criminal categories.
claims.qualification: Not all possible crime; not a deduplicated incident count.

claims.claim_summary: DV, dating violence and stalking are separate VAWA views; other reporting families excluded.
claims.qualification: Overlaps mean they are not added to the eleven-category sum.

claims.claim_summary: Fifteen category views: eleven individual criminal categories, their combined view, three VAWA categories.
claims.qualification: Arithmetic 11+1+3; not fifteen mutually exclusive crimes.

claims.claim_summary: 212 federal campuses map to the 42 selected institutions; enrollment counted once.
claims.qualification: Independent raw API identity checks and original-workbook aggregation; institution-wide, not main-campus incidence.

claims.claim_summary: The inventory contains 47 reporting campuses outside the United States.
claims.qualification: Country metadata corroborates notes; exposure populations are not separately measured.

claims.claim_summary: Some identified reporting campuses are medical facilities.
claims.qualification: Names independently checked; potential staff/patient exposure, not a measured composition adjustment.

claims.claim_summary: Fall headcount includes full-/part-time undergraduate and graduate/professional students; years matched.
claims.qualification: 126 annual EFTOTLT values independently re-read from original ZIPs at EFALEVEL=1.

claims.claim_summary: Distance-only students remain in the denominator.
claims.qualification: Their presence does not measure physically present exposure; no unsupported correction applied.

claims.claim_summary: Actual fall occupancy is documented for ten UCs and SDSU, 2022–2024.
claims.qualification: 33 independently transcribed cells; 31 institutions have no resident denominator, rather than zero residents.

claims.claim_summary: Housing normalization is approximate because properties have not been matched to Clery geography.
claims.qualification: This is a stated unresolved crosswalk, not a claim that the source occupancy is estimated.

claims.claim_summary: Housing offenses divided by total enrollment do not estimate resident risk.
claims.qualification: Numerator and population combination is labeled in the view.

claims.claim_summary: Annual ratio is scale times count divided by annual population.
claims.qualification: Default scale 1,000; 10,000 changes units only. Full precision retained until display.

claims.claim_summary: Pooled ratio divides summed counts by summed matched annual populations.
claims.qualification: Denominator-weighted mean; snapshots are not unique people or measured person-time.

claims.claim_summary: Ratios cannot estimate personal victimization probability or establish safety ordering.
claims.qualification: Descriptive choice; no causal or equivalence claim.

claims.claim_summary: Unknown counts/populations invalidate a rate; source zeros remain zero.
claims.qualification: Availability and missingness independently checked; structural no-housing status is separate from an observed numeric zero.

claims.claim_summary: All 42 have complete 2024 on-campus selected counts; six lack complete pooled totals.
claims.qualification: 2022 complete 36; 2023 complete 38; pooled incomplete Columbia, Florida, NYU, USC, UNC Chapel Hill, Virginia. Completeness means supplied cell coverage, not complete real-world reporting.

claims.locations: Methods applicability paragraph; dataset notes; source panel; PDF 2,5
claims.claim_summary: 2024 includes 103 numeric housing campuses and 109 explicitly declaring no housing; current declarations are applied to 2024 only.
claims.qualification: SurveyYear confirmed; no backfill of prior blank cells. The current API may include post-closure updates and supplements geography applicability only.

claims.claim_summary: UCSD housing rape 2022/23/24 is 12/11/20; SDSU main is 9/7/1.
claims.qualification: Separate versioned ASR main-campus comparison; 36-cell audit also covers other geographies.

claims.claim_summary: 2024 housing ratios round to 0.91 UCSD and 0.12 SDSU per 1,000.
claims.qualification: 20/21,907 and 1/8,367; approximate occupancy match.
Shown as 0.73/0.70; closeness does not establish equivalent safety.

claims.claim_summary: UCSC 2024 housing rape 38 includes 21 separate offenses disclosed in one report.
claims.qualification: Footnote 6, printed 11/PDF 12. Count retained; not 38 victims/report forms.

claims.claim_summary: UCSD 2022 on-campus rape is federal 14 versus ASR 15; noncampus 4 versus 5.
claims.qualification: 34 of 36 independently compared rape cells agree; two differences retained, not silently corrected.

claims.claim_summary: UCSD scooter/e-bike explanation concerns motor vehicle theft, not rape.
claims.qualification: No unsupported rape-trend explanation.

claims.claim_summary: SDSU 2024 IPEDS is 41,137; CDS and State Auditor 39,373.
claims.qualification: Difference unresolved; common IPEDS definition retained throughout enrollment views.

claims.claim_summary: The enrollment discrepancy is not resolved by claiming Imperial Valley was omitted.
claims.qualification: Budget explicitly labels SD & IV at 39,373; no alternative cause inferred.

claims.claim_summary: NCES uses reported campus crime per 10,000 FTE.
claims.qualification: Headcount, FTE and occupancy are not interchangeable; no unmatched benchmark imported.

claims.claim_summary: BJS compares survey and administrative reporting across nine pilot campuses.
claims.qualification: Alignment of geography, population, time and reporting is required.

claims.claim_summary: Narrowly aligned BJS survey estimate 60 rape incidents was not statistically different from 40 Clery rape incidents.
claims.qualification: Printed 110/PDF 131; completed on-campus rape reported to school authorities; survey undergraduates/2014–15 versus 2014 Clery. Not universal completeness.

claims.claim_summary: AAU 2019: 33 schools, 181,752 respondents, 21.9% overall response.
claims.qualification: Table 2; definitions/recall periods and resource contacts differ from Clery, no reporting multiplier.

claims.claim_summary: No universal reporting correction follows from these studies.
claims.qualification: No causal attribution to any named campus; targeted rather than systematic review.

claims.claim_summary: No hypothesis tests/confidence-band ranking; offenses are not independent unique victims.
claims.qualification: Study design decision; does not claim event-process models are universally invalid.

claims.locations: Explorer title, sort label, pair chart
claims.claim_summary: Rate sorting is descriptive; paired charts use a shared zero baseline and scale.
claims.qualification: Component inspected, including accessible captions, dynamic measure notes, unavailable values and offense-column label.

claims.claim_summary: 42 all-campus and 11 resident-normalized 2024 rows reproduce source-checked counts/populations/rates.
claims.qualification: 53 rows independently matched to rendered PDF text, all pages visually reviewed.

claims.claim_summary: Separate numerical audit checked 5,670 annual and 1,890 pooled rate rows.
claims.qualification: Audit record reviewed; its normalized-input starting point distinguished from this audit’s independent original-XLS/ZIP source reads.

claims.claim_summary: Research review, calculation audit and final citation audit have separate scopes.
claims.qualification: Automated/code-assisted independent review, not external human peer review.

claims.claim_summary: Aggregate extracts and code reproduce rates offline; original national extraction requires source downloads.
claims.qualification: Package integrity/reproduction gate is handled separately; this audit does not certify a not-yet-frozen archive.

claims.claim_summary: Reviewed outputs contain institutional aggregate counts, denominators and source notes.
claims.qualification: No victim-level records or identities in reviewed dataset/PDF; archive privacy is a separate gate.
